preflight.qualification: No matching workloads were running at preflight. This does not establish an otherwise idle or isolated desktop. Parent paused UI, tests and encoding for this trial.

change_under_test: Writing workbook is scoped in _write_xlsx; export_xlsx calls gc.collect after helper return and before the unchanged mandatory audit_xlsx. Weakref test requires writer workbook collection even with automatic cyclic GC disabled, then runs the real audit.

interpretation.caveat: Not an A/B trial: run timing, desktop load and code differ from original trials. Peak RSS is higher than original XLSX 10k trials, so do not claim a measured peak-memory improvement or assign speedup to the release fix.
